d: While investigating the death of his partner, a detective (Keanu Reeves) uncovers police corruption and a dangerous secret involving a young woman (Ana de Armas).
An injured cop, his partner and a troubled veteran must use stealth, smarts and marksmanship to take down a drug-dealing gang at a remote farm.
A divorcing couple (Alicia Silverstone, Ryan Kwanten) battle over who gets custody of their beloved dog.
A cutthroat Washington, D.C., lobbyist (Jessica Chastain) makes powerful new enemies by supporting a bill that imposes regulations on the sale of firearms.
A security guard (Liam Hemsworth) and his childhood pal (Michael Angarano) make plans to rob an armored car.
A small group of military personnel and some survivalists dwell in an underground bunker as they seek to find a cure in a world overrun by zombies.
The plan of three women (Malin Akerman, Nikki Reed, Deborah Ann Woll) to intercept a drug shipment for their boss (Bruce Willis) goes horribly wrong.
Steven (Ryan Phillippe) and Shannon (Rachelle Lefevre) risk their lives to uncover the truth behind their newly adopted daughter's disappearance in a small town.
A professor (Jason Sudeikis) collaborates with a grieving widow (Rebecca Hall) to write a biography about her husband, a folk singer who attracted a cult following.
